verdict.rationale: Twenty ships built-in Company and Person objects that can be linked through relations, and connected Google Workspace or Microsoft 365 emails and calendar events automatically appear on the matching Company and People records. That gives a partial per-record activity view. The docs never describe a unified activity timeline on each record, so the 'full activity timeline' part is only implied by email and calendar syncing. Missing for 10: an explicitly documented per-record activity timeline (notes, tasks, field-change history alongside emails and events), documentation of the default Person–Company link, and hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can manage contacts and companies as linked records with a full activity timeline on each

citations.quote: it immediately gets REST and GraphQL endpoints identical to built-in objects like Company or Person
You can create custom relations between any objects, including many-to-many relationships.
You need to reference the related object using a unique field from this object: the id, the email for People and Workspace Members, the domain for companies
Emails are automatically linked to the matching Company and People records
Emails and calendar events automatically appear on the relevant CRM records.
